Every session/analysis ID here was read live from the local database and cross-checked against ffprobe on 2026-08-04. This file does not store video contents, credentials, or storage secrets. Regenerate rather than hand-edit when a benchmark is replaced.

verifiedFps.conflictNote: RESOLVED in Phase 1 (2026-08-04, docs/phase-1-vanni-240-zone-time-report.md). Root cause: ffprobe's avg_frame_rate container tag (223.926) is a metadata artifact for this VFR HEVC file, not a measurement; classify_fps()'s native_source_class branch now prefers timestampFps (real per-frame decode-timestamp evidence) when it disagrees from the container average by more than 1%, matching the pattern already used by the validated_60/experimental_30 branches. Verified via a real production rerun (analysis a7679326-e193-4489-bf50-735fe402ec60, keeping the same analysis id; the pre-fix result was preserved as saved version 4b425ebf-6998-42d3-8105-0b5dfedcf93b): analysisFps/source_fps changed from 223.926 to 239.981, and all 6 reported metrics (zoneTimeS, avgIndividualStepLengthM, peakStrideLengthM, combinedStepFrequencyHz, zoneVelocityMps, maxVelocityMps) were reproduced to full floating-point precision — proving the timing pipeline was never actually driven by this label (crossingTime()/torsoSeries() in measurements.ts consume each frame's real persisted source timestamp directly, confirmed by tracing loadOverlayFrames.ts's `time: frame.tMs / 1000`).
